description: Source code for a Flutter screen widget (FolderDetailScreen) that displays details of a folder, including a list or grid of documents, and provides functionality for viewing, sharing, editing, and deleting documents and the folder itself.

classes.name: FolderDetailScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that shows details of a folder including its documents, with options to view, edit, share, delete, and toggle layout.

classes.name: _FolderDetailScreenState
classes.description: State class managing folder details, document list, user interactions, and UI updates for FolderDetailScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state, sets up repositories, change streams, and loads initial folder and document data.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Loads initial folder and documents data and sets up change stream listeners for real-time updates.

methods.name: _loadFolderAndDocs
methods.description: Fetches folder and document data from repositories.

methods.name: _toggleLayout
methods.description: Switches between grid and list layout for documents.

methods.name: _openDocument
methods.description: Navigates to the document viewing/editing screen.

methods.name: _deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a document after user confirmation, updates repositories, and deletes local file.

methods.name: _editDocument
methods.description: Prompts user to edit document name and tags, then updates the repository.

methods.name: _promptEditDocument
methods.description: Displays a dialog for editing document name and notes/tags.

methods.name: _renameFolder
methods.description: Allows renaming and editing description of the folder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the folder detail screen, including app bar, document list/grid, and other widgets.

methods.name: _buildList
methods.description: Builds a ListView of document tiles.

methods.name: _buildGrid
methods.description: Builds a GridView of document tiles with responsive cross-axis count.

methods.name: _pickIcon
methods.description: Selects an icon based on mime type for document representation.
